 .js-custom-arrow {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 10;
  height: 30px;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  opacity: 0;
  color: var(--palette__white);
  font-size: var(--text-xxxl);
 }

 @media (min-width: 768px) {
  .js-custom-arrow { display: none !important; }
 }

 .js-custom-arrow--left { left: 0; }
 .js-custom-arrow--right { right: 0; }

 .is-fading-left .js-custom-arrow--left { opacity: 0.5; }
 .is-fading-right .js-custom-arrow--right { opacity: 0.5; }

 .c-slider-carousel.is-swiping .js-custom-arrow {
  opacity: 0 !important;
 }

 .c-home-banner-wide .c-slider-carousel::after { display: none !important; }
</style>
<script>
 (function() {
  const applySliderLogic = () => {
   const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.c-home-banner-wide');

   containers.forEach(container => {
	const slider = container.querySelector('.c-slider-carousel');
	if (!slider) return;

	if (!slider.querySelector('.js-custom-arrow')) {
	 const leftBtn = document.createElement('div');
	 leftBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--left';
	 leftBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-left\'><\/use></svg>`;

	 const rightBtn = document.createElement('div');
	 rightBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--right';
	 rightBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-right\'><\/use></svg>`;

	 slider.appendChild(leftBtn);
	 slider.appendChild(rightBtn);
	}

	const updateStates = () => {
	 const currentPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-slider-page') || 0);
	 const lastPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-last-page') || 0);

	 slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-left', currentPage > 0);
	 slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-right', currentPage < lastPage);
	};

	new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
	 mutations.forEach(m => {
	  if (m.attributeName === 'data-slider-page') updateStates();
	 });
	}).observe(slider, { attributes: true });

	slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
	 slider.classList.add('is-swiping');
	}, {passive: true});

	slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
	 setTimeout(() => {
	  slider.classList.remove('is-swiping');
	 }, 200);
	}, {passive: true});

	updateStates();
   });
  };

  applySliderLogic();
  window.addEventListener('load', applySliderLogic);
 })();
</script>

<style>
        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel { position: relative; }

        .js-custom-arrow {
            display: block;
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            z-index: 10;
            height: 30px;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
            opacity: 0;
            color: var(--palette__white);
            font-size: var(--text-xxxl);
        }

        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .js-custom-arrow { display: none !important; }
        }

        .js-custom-arrow--left { left: 0; }
        .js-custom-arrow--right { right: 0; }

        .is-fading-left .js-custom-arrow--left { opacity: 0.5; }
        .is-fading-right .js-custom-arrow--right { opacity: 0.5; }

        .c-slider-carousel.is-swiping .js-custom-arrow {
            opacity: 0 !important;
        }

        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel::before,
        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel::after { display: none !important; }
    </style>
<script>
        (function() {
            const applySliderLogic = () => {
                const slider = document.querySelector('.c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel');
                if (!slider) return;

                const style = window.getComputedStyle(slider);
                const nbSm = parseFloat(style.getPropertyValue('--slider__nb--sm').trim());

                if (Number.isInteger(nbSm)) {
                    if (!slider.querySelector('.js-custom-arrow')) {
                        const leftBtn = document.createElement('div');
                        leftBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--left';
                        leftBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-left\'><\/use></svg>`;

                        const rightBtn = document.createElement('div');
                        rightBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--right';
                        rightBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-right\'><\/use></svg>`;

                        slider.appendChild(leftBtn);
                        slider.appendChild(rightBtn);
                    }

                    const updateStates = () => {
                        const currentPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-slider-page') || 0);
                        const lastPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-last-page') || 0);

                        slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-left', currentPage > 0);
                        slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-right', currentPage < lastPage);
                    };

                    new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
                        mutations.forEach(m => {
                            if (m.attributeName === 'data-slider-page') updateStates();
                        });
                    }).observe(slider, { attributes: true });

                    slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                        slider.classList.add('is-swiping');
                    }, {passive: true});

                    slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            slider.classList.remove('is-swiping');
                        }, 200);
                    }, {passive: true});

                    updateStates();
                }
            };

            window.addEventListener('load', applySliderLogic);
        })();
    </script>

 contentLoader(()=>{

  const swapFile = (url, file) => file && url ? url.replace(/\/([^\/\s]+)(\s.*)?$/, `/${file}$2`) : url;

  $(document).off('mouseenter.bedCollection', '.js-change-image-collection')
   .on('mouseenter.bedCollection', '.js-change-image-collection', function() {

   const data = $(this).data();

   const $card = $(this).closest('.c-card-collection__gallery');
   const $picture = $card.find('.js-image-collection picture');

   const newFiles = [
          data.hoverSm,
          data.hoverSm,
          data.hoverMd,
          data.hoverLg,
          data.hoverLg
        ];

   $picture.find('source').each(function(index) {
	$(this).attr('srcset', (i, currentSrcset) => swapFile(currentSrcset, newFiles[index]));
   });

   const fallbackFile = data.hoverLg || data.hoverMd || data.hoverSm;
   $picture.find('img').attr('src', (i, currentSrc) => swapFile(currentSrc, fallbackFile));
  });

  setTimeout(()=>{
   $('.js-change-image-collection').find('picture').addClass('u-bg-image');
  },1000)

 });
</script>

<style>
 .c-home-banner-wide .c-home-block {
  --group-section__font-size--title: var(--text-md);
  --group-section__font-size-sm--title: var(--text-xl);
  --group-section__font-size-md--title: calc(var(--text-md) * 1.9);
 }
 
 .c-home-banner-wide .c-slider-carousel { position: relative; }

 .js-custom-arrow {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 10;
  height: 30px;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  opacity: 0;
  color: var(--palette__white);
  font-size: var(--text-xxxl);
 }

 @media (min-width: 768px) {
  .js-custom-arrow { display: none !important; }
 }

 .js-custom-arrow--left { left: 0; }
 .js-custom-arrow--right { right: 0; }

 .is-fading-left .js-custom-arrow--left { opacity: 0.5; }
 .is-fading-right .js-custom-arrow--right { opacity: 0.5; }

 .c-slider-carousel.is-swiping .js-custom-arrow {
  opacity: 0 !important;
 }

 .c-home-banner-wide .c-slider-carousel::before,
 .c-home-banner-wide .c-slider-carousel::after { display: none !important; }
</style>
<script>
 (function() {
  const applySliderLogic = () => {
   const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.c-home-banner-wide');

   containers.forEach(container => {
	const slider = container.querySelector('.c-slider-carousel');
	if (!slider) return;

	if (!slider.querySelector('.js-custom-arrow')) {
	 const leftBtn = document.createElement('div');
	 leftBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--left';
	 leftBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-left\'><\/use></svg>`;

	 const rightBtn = document.createElement('div');
	 rightBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--right';
	 rightBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-right\'><\/use></svg>`;

	 slider.appendChild(leftBtn);
	 slider.appendChild(rightBtn);
	}

	const updateStates = () => {
	 const currentPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-slider-page') || 0);
	 const lastPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-last-page') || 0);

	 slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-left', currentPage > 0);
	 slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-right', currentPage < lastPage);
	};

	new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
	 mutations.forEach(m => {
	  if (m.attributeName === 'data-slider-page') updateStates();
	 });
	}).observe(slider, { attributes: true });

	slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
	 slider.classList.add('is-swiping');
	}, {passive: true});

	slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
	 setTimeout(() => {
	  slider.classList.remove('is-swiping');
	 }, 200);
	}, {passive: true});

	updateStates();
   });
  };

  applySliderLogic();
  window.addEventListener('load', applySliderLogic);
 })();
</script>

                    if (!slider.querySelector('.js-custom-arrow')) {
                        const leftBtn = document.createElement('div');
                        leftBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--left';
                        leftBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-left\'><\/use></svg>`;

                        const rightBtn = document.createElement('div');
                        rightBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--right';
                        rightBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-right\'><\/use></svg>`;

                        slider.appendChild(leftBtn);
                        slider.appendChild(rightBtn);
                    }

                    const updateStates = () => {
                        const currentPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-slider-page') || 0);
                        const lastPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-last-page') || 0);

                        slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-left', currentPage > 0);
                        slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-right', currentPage < lastPage);
                    };

                    new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
                        mutations.forEach(m => {
                            if (m.attributeName === 'data-slider-page') updateStates();
                        });
                    }).observe(slider, { attributes: true });

                    slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                        slider.classList.add('is-swiping');
                    }, {passive: true});

                    slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            slider.classList.remove('is-swiping');
                        }, 200);
                    }, {passive: true});

                    updateStates();
                }
            };

            window.addEventListener('load', applySliderLogic);
        })();
    </script>

          data.hoverLg
        ];

   $picture.find('img').attr('src', (i, currentSrc) => swapFile(currentSrc, fallbackFile));

   const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.c-home-banner-wide');

   containers.forEach(container => {
	const slider = container.querySelector('.c-slider-carousel');
	if (!slider) return;

	if (!slider.querySelector('.js-custom-arrow')) {
	 const leftBtn = document.createElement('div');
	 leftBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--left';
	 leftBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-left\'><\/use></svg>`;

	 const rightBtn = document.createElement('div');
	 rightBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--right';
	 rightBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-right\'><\/use></svg>`;

	 slider.appendChild(leftBtn);
	 slider.appendChild(rightBtn);
	}

	const updateStates = () => {
	 const currentPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-slider-page') || 0);
	 const lastPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-last-page') || 0);

	 slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-left', currentPage > 0);
	 slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-right', currentPage < lastPage);
	};

	new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
	 mutations.forEach(m => {
	  if (m.attributeName === 'data-slider-page') updateStates();
	 });
	}).observe(slider, { attributes: true });

	slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
	 slider.classList.add('is-swiping');
	}, {passive: true});

	slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
	 setTimeout(() => {
	  slider.classList.remove('is-swiping');
	 }, 200);
	}, {passive: true});

	updateStates();
   });
  };

  applySliderLogic();
  window.addEventListener('load', applySliderLogic);
 })();
</script>

<style>
        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel { position: relative; }

        .js-custom-arrow {
            display: block;
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            z-index: 10;
            height: 30px;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
            opacity: 0;
            color: var(--palette__white);
            font-size: var(--text-xxxl);
        }

        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .js-custom-arrow { display: none !important; }
        }

        .js-custom-arrow--left { left: 0; }
        .js-custom-arrow--right { right: 0; }

        .is-fading-left .js-custom-arrow--left { opacity: 0.5; }
        .is-fading-right .js-custom-arrow--right { opacity: 0.5; }

        .c-slider-carousel.is-swiping .js-custom-arrow {
            opacity: 0 !important;
        }

        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel::before,
        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel::after { display: none !important; }
    </style>
<script>
        (function() {
            const applySliderLogic = () => {
                const slider = document.querySelector('.c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel');
                if (!slider) return;

                const style = window.getComputedStyle(slider);
                const nbSm = parseFloat(style.getPropertyValue('--slider__nb--sm').trim());

                if (Number.isInteger(nbSm)) {
                    if (!slider.querySelector('.js-custom-arrow')) {
                        const leftBtn = document.createElement('div');
                        leftBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--left';
                        leftBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-left\'><\/use></svg>`;

                        const rightBtn = document.createElement('div');
                        rightBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--right';
                        rightBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-right\'><\/use></svg>`;

                        slider.appendChild(leftBtn);
                        slider.appendChild(rightBtn);
                    }

                    const updateStates = () => {
                        const currentPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-slider-page') || 0);
                        const lastPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-last-page') || 0);

                        slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-left', currentPage > 0);
                        slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-right', currentPage < lastPage);
                    };

                    new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
                        mutations.forEach(m => {
                            if (m.attributeName === 'data-slider-page') updateStates();
                        });
                    }).observe(slider, { attributes: true });

                    slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                        slider.classList.add('is-swiping');
                    }, {passive: true});

                    slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            slider.classList.remove('is-swiping');
                        }, 200);
                    }, {passive: true});

                    updateStates();
                }
            };

            window.addEventListener('load', applySliderLogic);
        })();
    </script>

 }
 
 .c-home-banner-wide .c-slider-carousel { position: relative; }

 .js-custom-arrow {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 10;
  height: 30px;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  opacity: 0;
  color: var(--palette__white);
  font-size: var(--text-xxxl);
 }

 @media (min-width: 768px) {
  .js-custom-arrow { display: none !important; }
 }

 .js-custom-arrow--left { left: 0; }
 .js-custom-arrow--right { right: 0; }

 .is-fading-left .js-custom-arrow--left { opacity: 0.5; }
 .is-fading-right .js-custom-arrow--right { opacity: 0.5; }

 .c-slider-carousel.is-swiping .js-custom-arrow {
  opacity: 0 !important;
 }

 .c-home-banner-wide .c-slider-carousel::before,
 .c-home-banner-wide .c-slider-carousel::after { display: none !important; }
</style>
<script>
 (function() {
  const applySliderLogic = () => {
   const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.c-home-banner-wide');

   containers.forEach(container => {
	const slider = container.querySelector('.c-slider-carousel');
	if (!slider) return;

	if (!slider.querySelector('.js-custom-arrow')) {
	 const leftBtn = document.createElement('div');
	 leftBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--left';
	 leftBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-left\'><\/use></svg>`;

	 const rightBtn = document.createElement('div');
	 rightBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--right';
	 rightBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-right\'><\/use></svg>`;

	 slider.appendChild(leftBtn);
	 slider.appendChild(rightBtn);
	}

	const updateStates = () => {
	 const currentPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-slider-page') || 0);
	 const lastPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-last-page') || 0);

	 slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-left', currentPage > 0);
	 slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-right', currentPage < lastPage);
	};

	new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
	 mutations.forEach(m => {
	  if (m.attributeName === 'data-slider-page') updateStates();
	 });
	}).observe(slider, { attributes: true });

	slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
	 slider.classList.add('is-swiping');
	}, {passive: true});

	slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
	 setTimeout(() => {
	  slider.classList.remove('is-swiping');
	 }, 200);
	}, {passive: true});

	updateStates();
   });
  };

  applySliderLogic();
  window.addEventListener('load', applySliderLogic);
 })();
</script>

<style>
        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel { position: relative; }

        .js-custom-arrow {
            display: block;
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            z-index: 10;
            height: 30px;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
            opacity: 0;
            color: var(--palette__white);
            font-size: var(--text-xxxl);
        }

        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .js-custom-arrow { display: none !important; }
        }

        .js-custom-arrow--left { left: 0; }
        .js-custom-arrow--right { right: 0; }

        .is-fading-left .js-custom-arrow--left { opacity: 0.5; }
        .is-fading-right .js-custom-arrow--right { opacity: 0.5; }

        .c-slider-carousel.is-swiping .js-custom-arrow {
            opacity: 0 !important;
        }

        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel::before,
        .c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel::after { display: none !important; }
    </style>
<script>
        (function() {
            const applySliderLogic = () => {
                const slider = document.querySelector('.c-home-special-price .c-slider-carousel');
                if (!slider) return;

                const style = window.getComputedStyle(slider);
                const nbSm = parseFloat(style.getPropertyValue('--slider__nb--sm').trim());

                if (Number.isInteger(nbSm)) {
                    if (!slider.querySelector('.js-custom-arrow')) {
                        const leftBtn = document.createElement('div');
                        leftBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--left';
                        leftBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-left\'><\/use></svg>`;

                        const rightBtn = document.createElement('div');
                        rightBtn.className = 'js-custom-arrow js-custom-arrow--right';
                        rightBtn.innerHTML = `<svg class="o-icon"><use xlink:href=\'/es/svg/skl_v2.svg?v=261113.111#icon-chevron-right\'><\/use></svg>`;

                        slider.appendChild(leftBtn);
                        slider.appendChild(rightBtn);
                    }

                    const updateStates = () => {
                        const currentPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-slider-page') || 0);
                        const lastPage = parseInt(slider.getAttribute('data-last-page') || 0);

                        slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-left', currentPage > 0);
                        slider.classList.toggle('is-fading-right', currentPage < lastPage);
                    };

                    new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
                        mutations.forEach(m => {
                            if (m.attributeName === 'data-slider-page') updateStates();
                        });
                    }).observe(slider, { attributes: true });

                    slider.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
                        slider.classList.add('is-swiping');
                    }, {passive: true});

                    slider.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            slider.classList.remove('is-swiping');
                        }, 200);
                    }, {passive: true});

                    updateStates();
                }
            };

            window.addEventListener('load', applySliderLogic);
        })();
    </script>

    <script>

 contentLoader(()=>{

  const swapFile = (url, file) => file && url ? url.replace(/\/([^\/\s]+)(\s.*)?$/, `/${file}$2`) : url;

  $(document).off('mouseenter.bedCollection', '.js-change-image-collection')
   .on('mouseenter.bedCollection', '.js-change-image-collection', function() {

   const data = $(this).data();

   const $card = $(this).closest('.c-card-collection__gallery');
   const $picture = $card.find('.js-image-collection picture');

   const newFiles = [
          data.hoverSm,
          data.hoverSm,
          data.hoverMd,
          data.hoverLg,
          data.hoverLg
        ];

   $picture.find('source').each(function(index) {
	$(this).attr('srcset', (i, currentSrcset) => swapFile(currentSrcset, newFiles[index]));
   });

   const fallbackFile = data.hoverLg || data.hoverMd || data.hoverSm;
   $picture.find('img').attr('src', (i, currentSrc) => swapFile(currentSrc, fallbackFile));
  });

  setTimeout(()=>{
   $('.js-change-image-collection').find('picture').addClass('u-bg-image');
  },1000)

 });
</script>
